summary.text: Adam Gómez is a Democratic state senator representing the Hampden District, in office since January 2021, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner and says he lives in Springfield.

paragraphs.text: Adam Gómez lives in Springfield, Massachusetts.
His career experience includes working as resident service coordinator and property manager with the Veterans Outreach Center of Massachusetts Inc. and owning Brightwood Press.
Gómez assumed office in the State Senate on January 6, 2021, succeeding James Welch, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Joint Committee on Cannabis Policy and the Joint Committee on Community Development and Small Businesses.
